_comment: Performance budget (PLAN Tahap 9). Bundle sizes are gzip KB (1024) of the production build; routes are what `npm run e2e:perf` measures on the mobile profile. API call counts are deterministic, so each route's ceiling is what it costs today: raise one only with the reason in the same change. LCP is NOT gated here (a lab number that moves with the machine); it stays in e2e/reports/BASELINE.md.

bundle._reason_totalGzipKB: 20 Nov 2026 (paket WO Tahap 3–5): the Penawaran screens (list, quotation page, Jadikan proyek and about twenty dialogs and drawers), the shared rincian editor and the Tagihan vendor screens add ~85 KB of lazily loaded chunks only; the entry stays ~152 KB of 165 and no first page grew. Total is 844 KB; the ceiling moves to 870. Earlier: 19 Nov 2026 (Tahap 1, ADR-0049) moved it from 720 to 760
